segments.text: Let each word arrive like a small, slow wave on a quiet shore. You do not have to hold any of them. They simply come, and go, and ease you down.
Warmer. Softer. Heavier with every line. The sand holds you. The tide breathes for you. Lower, and slower, and further from the day.
And now you no longer need the words at all. Let your eyes close, and let the tide carry you the rest of the way down into sleep.
